## Scope

This section governs requests for BNR data that are not already available as
approved public aggregate outputs. It does not change the analytical
publication workflows for public statistics.

Use the least detailed data that can meet an approved purpose. Deidentified
record-level data remain non-public and require a recorded decision and any
applicable agreement, ethics and security controls.

## Authoritative route

1. [Handle the data-access request](data-access-requests.qmd).
2. Follow the [data-sharing procedure](../data/data-governance/sharing-sop.qmd).
3. Complete the [Data Sharing Agreement](../data/data-governance/dsa-om.qmd)
   where required.

## Responsibilities

- The **BNR Lead** owns the governance decision and confirms the authorised
  decision route.
- The **BNR Analyst** defines and prepares the minimum approved dataset and
  checks proposed outputs.
- The **BNR Developer** supports secure, reproducible preparation and transfer
  without placing confidential material in Git.

The person or body authorised to approve each access class is a BNR policy
decision. Do not infer authority from technical access or from the ability to
prepare a dataset.

## Public/private boundary

Applications, requester details, agreements, ethics evidence, approval records,
transfer logs and non-public datasets remain in authorised private systems.
Only approved public-safe summaries or outputs may enter the Info-Hub.
